description: A reactive value that Angular reads by calling it, so a template or computed value updates when it changes.
The injectable service that sends HTTP requests and returns cold Observables typed by a generic argument.
An Observable that sends nothing until it is subscribed to, so an unsubscribed HTTP call never leaves the browser.
A signal-based wrapper around HttpClient that sends its request eagerly and sends another when a signal it reads changes.
The signals isLoading, error, hasValue and value that describe a resource, where reading value in the error state throws.
The starting value of a resource, which removes undefined from the type of value and lets a template loop at once.
The error that HttpClient reports for a failed request, whose status is 0 when no HTTP answer arrived.
